messages:
deploybot: Canary rollout r-2026-03-19 -> HOLD. Observed sustained p95 latency increase on dedicated-gpu-pool-2 (from 120ms -> 420ms). No errors, but elevated tail latency. Auto-rollback disabled. tagging @eng-oncall for decision.

alex: saw metrics, thx. Which customers on that pool? Any high-sensitivity SLAs?

anya: TeamTenant A and B are pinned to that pool (reserved). Traffic mix: embed-heavy + low concurrency. Might be impacting batch jobs.

miguel: Can we pin traffic back to r-2026-03-12 (previous) quickly? That should be safe and preserves cache state.

alex: Ops/rollback timeline? We need comms to customers + statuspage text before we touch rollout. Avoid alarmism but be transparent.

sara: Drafting statuspage + email snippets below. Two options: concise vs detailed. Which do we prefer?

sara: CONCISE statuspage snippet (for public page):
```
Title: Degraded latency for dedicated inference pool (mitigated)
Impact: A subset of customers using dedicated-gpu-pool-2 may have experienced increased response times for inference requests between 11:22 and 11:46 UTC.
Current status: Mitigation underway; rollback to previous version in progress. No data loss.
```

sara: DETAILED internal statuspage (for subscribers/incident):
```
Observed: p95 latency jump from ~120ms to ~420ms on dedicated-gpu-pool-2 during canary expansion at 11:20 UTC.
Root cause: under investigation (kernel scheduling interaction suspected).
Mitigation: holding rollout, initiating immediate rollback to model runtime v1.4.3. Expected restoration within 30m.
Customer impact: increased tail latency for inference only; request/response integrity unchanged.
Next updates: at 11:50, or earlier if resolved.
```

anya: I prefer the detailed one for customers on reserved plans (they get more transparency) and concise for public page.

miguel: Agree. Also prepare a short email for reserved customers: subject + 3-bullet summary + action items.

sara: Email draft (reserved customers):
Subject: Brief latency degradation and mitigation on dedicated capacity (Mar 19)
Body:
Hi —
We observed elevated inference latency on dedicated-gpu-pool-2 during a canary expansion at 11:20 UTC. We have paused the rollout and are rolling back to the previous runtime to restore normal performance.
What we did: paused deploy, rolling back to v1.4.3, monitoring closely.
What you may have seen: increased p95 response times between ~11:22–11:46 UTC. No errors or data exposure.
What we recommend: no action required. If you notice persistent errors, reply and we'll prioritize.
Expected follow-up: confirmation once rollback completes (within ~30m).
Thanks, Redwood Inference Ops

alex: Good. Ops: go ahead with rollback when statuspage/email copy is queued. Post update to statuspage before customer emails.

ops-bot: Rollback job queued: rollback-id cb-1795 -> target v1.4.3. ETA 18 minutes. Will post updates to #eng-oncall on completion.

miguel: Rolling back now. I’ll watch the metrics and post a resolution update.

(20m later) miguel: Rollback complete. p95 back to ~110ms, no errors.

alex: Great. Sara — post the concise public status now and send reserved-customer email.

sara: Posted public update and queued reserved email. Copy stored in #support-drafts.

ops-bot: Statuspage updated: Degraded latency — mitigated (update id sp-7821). Customer emails queued (batch 1/2 sent).

alex: Closing thread. Follow-up: create a short postmortem with timeline + kernel task reference. Assign to @miguel for RCA.

miguel: On it. Will open postmortem and ping the kernel team.
